response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), stats AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM per) SELECT p.status AS healtheval, p.total_scans, p.rate, p.rate - st.avg_rate AS rate_minus_avg FROM per p CROSS JOIN stats st WHERE p.rate > st.avg_rate

assumptions.assumption: A spanmin of 0 gives a missing ratio (via NULLIF) and is ignored in the average, rather than causing an error. Scans with a NULL gbsize or spanmin are also ignored.
Sites with a NULL healtheval form their own group (NULL status). That group counts toward the average across statuses and can appear in the output if its rate is above the average.
The average across statuses is the unweighted mean of the per-status rates. Statuses whose rate is NULL are ignored in that mean.

alternatives.interpretation: Leave out the NULL healtheval group, so only real statuses are grouped and averaged.
alternatives.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.healtheval IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.healtheval), stats AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM per) SELECT p.status AS healtheval, p.total_scans, p.rate, p.rate - st.avg_rate AS rate_minus_avg FROM per p CROSS JOIN stats st WHERE p.rate > st.avg_rate
